title: Duke Tobin sends out 'not comfortable' head coach Zac Taylor to explain Bengals' trade-deadline snafu with Eagles

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Duke Tobin sends out 'not comfortable' head coach Zac Taylor to explain Bengals' trade-deadline snafu with Eagles
sources.description: Zac Taylor almost certainly had little to nothing to do with the trade-deadline snafu in which the Bengals backed out of an agreed-upon deal with the Eagles. But he was left to explain it.
